versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐξῆλθεν δόγμα παρὰ Καίσαρος Αὐγούστου ἀπογράφεσθαι πᾶσαν τὴν οἰκουμένην.

controles.web: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
controles.livre: E aconteceu naqueles dias que saiu um decreto da parte de César Augusto, para que todo a terra se registrasse.

versos.grego: αὕτη ἀπογραφὴ πρώτη ἐγένετο ἡγεμονεύοντος τῆς Συρίας Κυρηνίου.

controles.web: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
controles.kjv: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
controles.livre: (Esse primeiro censo foi feito quando Quirino era o governador da Síria.)

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπορεύοντο πάντες ἀπογράφεσθαι, ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ πόλιν.

controles.web: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
controles.kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
controles.livre: E todos foram se registrar, cada um à sua própria cidade.

versos.grego: Ἀνέβη δὲ καὶ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐκ πόλεως Ναζαρὲθ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν εἰς πόλιν Δαυεὶδ ἥτις καλεῖται Βηθλεέμ, διὰ τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐξ οἴκου καὶ πατριᾶς Δαυείδ,

controles.web: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;
controles.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
controles.livre: E José também subiu da Galileia, da cidade de Nazaré à Judeia, à cidade de Davi, que se chama Belém; (porque ele era da casa e família de Davi.)

versos.grego: ἀπογράψασθαι σὺν Μαριὰμ τῇ ἐμνηστευμένῃ αὐτῷ, οὔσῃ ἐγκύῳ.

controles.web: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
controles.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
controles.livre: Para se registrar com Maria, com ele prometida em casamento, que estava grávida.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν,

controles.web: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
controles.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, enquanto eles ali, completaram-se os dias em que ela havia de dar à luz.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔτεκεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν πρωτότοκον, καὶ ἐσπαργάνωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀνέκλινεν αὐτὸν ἐν φάτνῃ, διότι οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τόπος ἐν τῷ καταλύματι.

controles.web: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
controles.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
controles.livre: E deu à luz seu filho primogênito, e o envolveu em panos, e o deitou numa manjedoura; porque não havia lugar para eles na hospedaria.

versos.grego: Καὶ ποιμένες ἦσαν ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῇ αὐτῇ ἀγραυλοῦντες καὶ φυλάσσοντες φυλακὰς τῆς νυκτὸς ἐπὶ τὴν ποίμνην αὐτῶν.

controles.web: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
controles.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
controles.livre: E naquela mesma localidade havia pastores que estavam no campo, e vigiavam o seu rebanho durante as vigílias da noite.

versos.grego: καὶ ἄγγελος Κυρίου ἐπέστη αὐτοῖς καὶ δόξα Κυρίου περιέλαμψεν αὐτούς, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν.

controles.web: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
controles.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
controles.livre: E um anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu, e a glória do Senhor os cercou de resplendor. Então tiveram grande temor.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ ἄγγελος Μὴ φοβεῖσθε· ἰδοὺ γὰρ εὐαγγελίζομαι ὑμῖν χαρὰν μεγάλην, ἥτις ἔσται παντὶ τῷ λαῷ,

controles.web: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
controles.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
controles.livre: E o anjo lhes disse: Não temais; pois eis que vos dou notícias de grande alegria, que será para todo o povo:

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐτέχθη ὑμῖν σήμερον Σωτήρ, ὅς ἐστιν Χριστὸς Κύριος, ἐν πόλει Δαυείδ.

controles.web: For there is born to you, this day, in the city of David, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
controles.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
controles.livre: que hoje na cidade de Davi vos nasceu o Salvador, que é Cristo, o Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ τοῦτο ὑμῖν σημεῖον, εὑρήσετε βρέφος ἐσπαργανωμένον καὶ κείμενον ἐν φάτνῃ.

controles.web: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
controles.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
controles.livre: E isto vos será por sinal: achareis o menino envolto em panos, deitado numa manjedoura.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξαίφνης ἐγένετο σὺν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ πλῆθος στρατιᾶς οὐρανίου αἰνούντων τὸν Θεὸν καὶ λεγόντων

controles.web: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,
controles.kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
controles.livre: E no mesmo instante apareceu com o anjo uma multidão de exércitos celestiais, louvando a Deus, e dizendo:

versos.grego: Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις Θεῷ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς εἰρήνη ἐν ἀνθρώποις εὐδοκίας.

controles.web: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
controles.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
controles.livre: Glória nas alturas a Deus, paz na terra aos seres humanos de quem ele se agrada.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀπῆλθον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οἱ ἄγγελοι, οἱ ποιμένες ἐλάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους Διέλθωμεν δὴ ἕως Βηθλεὲμ καὶ ἴδωμεν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τὸ γεγονὸς ὃ ὁ Κύριος ἐγνώρισεν ἡμῖν.

controles.web: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said one to another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando os anjos se ausentaram deles para o céu, os pastores disseram uns aos outros: Vamos, pois, até Belém, e vejamos isso que aconteceu, e o Senhor nos informou.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦλθαν σπεύσαντες, καὶ ἀνεῦραν τήν τε Μαριὰμ καὶ τὸν Ἰωσὴφ καὶ τὸ βρέφος κείμενον ἐν τῇ φάτνῃ·

controles.web: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
controles.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
controles.livre: Então foram apressadamente, e acharam Maria, e José, e o menino deitado na manjedoura.

versos.grego: ἰδόντες δὲ ἐγνώρισαν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ λαληθέντος αὐτοῖς περὶ τοῦ παιδίου τούτου.

controles.web: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
controles.kjv: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
controles.livre: Quando o viram, contaram o que lhes havia sido dito sobre o menino.

versos.grego: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐθαύμασαν περὶ τῶν λαληθέντων ὑπὸ τῶν ποιμένων πρὸς αὐτούς·

controles.web: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
controles.kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
controles.livre: E todos os que ouviram se admiraram com o que os pastores lhes diziam.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ Μαρία πάντα συνετήρει τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα συνβάλλουσα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς.

controles.web: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
controles.kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
controles.livre: Mas Maria guardava todas essas palavras, considerando -as no seu coração.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑπέστρεψαν οἱ ποιμένες δοξάζοντες καὶ αἰνοῦντες τὸν Θεὸν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἤκουσαν καὶ εἶδον καθὼς ἐλαλήθη πρὸς αὐτούς.

controles.web: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
controles.kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
controles.livre: Os pastores voltaram glorificando e louvando a Deus por tudo o que haviam ouvido e visto, como lhes havia sido dito.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ τοῦ περιτεμεῖν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦς, τὸ κληθὲν ὑπὸ τοῦ ἀγγέλου πρὸ τοῦ συλλημφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ.

controles.web: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
controles.kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
controles.livre: Quando se completaram os oito dias para circuncidá-lo, foi chamado o seu nome Jesus, o qual havia sido posto pelo anjo antes que fosse concebido.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸν νόμον Μωϋσέως, ἀνήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παραστῆσαι τῷ Κυρίῳ,

controles.web: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord
controles.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
controles.livre: E quando se completaram os dias da purificação deles,  segundo a Lei de Moisés, o levaram a Jerusalém, para o apresentarem ao Senhor,

versos.grego: καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν νόμῳ Κυρίου ὅτι Πᾶν ἄρσεν διανοῖγον μήτραν ἅγιον τῷ Κυρίῳ κληθήσεται,

controles.web: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
controles.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
controles.livre: conforme o que está escrito na Lei do Senhor: Todo macho primogênito  será consagrado ao Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ τοῦ δοῦναι θυσίαν κατὰ τὸ εἰρημένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Κυρίου, ζεῦγος τρυγόνων ἢ δύο νοσσοὺς περιστερῶν.

controles.web: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
controles.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
controles.livre: E para darem a oferta segundo o que se diz na Lei do Senhor: um par de rolinhas ou dois pombinhos.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος ἦν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ᾧ ὄνομα Συμεών, καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος δίκαιος καὶ εὐλαβής, προσδεχόμενος παράκλησιν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ Πνεῦμα ἦν Ἅγιον ἐπ’ αὐτόν·

controles.web: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
controles.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
controles.livre: E eis que havia em Jerusalém um homem de nome Simeão; e esse homem era justo e devoto, e esperava a consolação de Israel; e o Espírito Santo estava sobre ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν αὐτῷ κεχρηματισμένον ὑπὸ τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Ἁγίου μὴ ἰδεῖν θάνατον πρὶν ἢ ἂν ἴδῃ τὸν Χριστὸν Κυρίου.

controles.web: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
controles.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
controles.livre: E havia lhe sido revelado pelo Espírito Santo que ele não veria a morte antes de ter visto o Cristo do Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦλθεν ἐν τῷ Πνεύματι εἰς τὸ ἱερόν· καὶ ἐν τῷ εἰσαγαγεῖν τοὺς γονεῖς τὸ παιδίον Ἰησοῦν τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὸ εἰθισμένον τοῦ νόμου περὶ αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
controles.kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
controles.livre: E pelo Espírito foi ao Templo; e quando os pais trouxeram o menino Jesus, para fazerem com ele conforme o costume da Lei,

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδέξατο αὐτὸ εἰς τὰς ἀγκάλας καὶ εὐλόγησεν τὸν Θεὸν καὶ εἶπεν

controles.web: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,
controles.kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
controles.livre: Então ele o tomou em seus braços, louvou a Deus, e disse:

versos.grego: Νῦν ἀπολύεις τὸν δοῦλόν σου, Δέσποτα, κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἐν εἰρήνῃ·

controles.web: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
controles.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
controles.livre: Agora, Senhor, despedes o teu servo em paz, conforme a tua palavra,

versos.grego: ὅτι εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου τὸ σωτήριόν σου,

controles.web: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
controles.kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
controles.livre: pois os meus olhos viram a tua salvação,

versos.grego: ὃ ἡτοίμασας κατὰ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν λαῶν,

controles.web: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
controles.kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
controles.livre: a qual preparaste diante de todos os povos;

versos.grego: φῶς εἰς ἀποκάλυψιν ἐθνῶν καὶ δόξαν λαοῦ σου Ἰσραήλ.

controles.web: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
controles.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
controles.livre: Luz para iluminar as gentios, e para a glória do teu povo Israel.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ θαυμάζοντες ἐπὶ τοῖς λαλουμένοις περὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him,
controles.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
controles.livre: E seu pai  e sua mãe se admiraram das coisas que se diziam sobre ele.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς Συμεὼν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Μαριὰμ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ Ἰδοὺ οὗτος κεῖται εἰς πτῶσιν καὶ ἀνάστασιν πολλῶν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ εἰς σημεῖον ἀντιλεγόμενον

controles.web: and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
controles.kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
controles.livre: Simeão os abençoou, e disse a Maria, sua mãe: Eis que este é posto para queda e levantamento de muitos em Israel; e para sinal que terá oposição,

versos.grego: —καὶ σοῦ δὲ αὐτῆς τὴν ψυχὴν διελεύσεται ῥομφαία—, ὅπως ἂν ἀποκαλυφθῶσιν ἐκ πολλῶν καρδιῶν διαλογισμοί.

controles.web: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
controles.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
controles.livre: (também uma espada atravessará a tua própria alma) para que os pensamentos de muitos corações se manifestem.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἦν Ἄννα προφῆτις, θυγάτηρ Φανουήλ, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσήρ· αὕτη προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ἡμέραις πολλαῖς, ζήσασα μετὰ ἀνδρὸς ἔτη ἑπτὰ ἀπὸ τῆς παρθενίας αὐτῆς,

controles.web: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
controles.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
controles.livre: E estava ali a profetiza Ana, filha de Fanuel, da tribo de Aser. Ela já tinha idade avançada, e havia vivido com o marido sete anos desde sua virgindade.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὴ χήρα ἕως ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα τεσσάρων, ἣ οὐκ ἀφίστατο τοῦ ἱεροῦ νηστείαις καὶ δεήσεσιν λατρεύουσα νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν.

controles.web: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
controles.kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
controles.livre: E era viúva até os oitenta e quatro anos, e não se afastava do Templo, servindo a Deus com jejuns e orações, de noite e de dia.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐπιστᾶσα ἀνθωμολογεῖτο τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς προσδεχομένοις λύτρωσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ.

controles.web: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E ela veio na mesma hora; ela agradeci a Deus, e falava dele a todos os que esperavam a redenção de Jerusalém.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὡς ἐτέλεσαν πάντα τὰ κατὰ τὸν νόμον Κυρίου, ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς πόλιν ἑαυτῶν Ναζαρέθ.

controles.web: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
controles.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
controles.livre: E quando acabaram de cumprir tudo, segundo a Lei do Senhor, voltaram à Galileia, para a sua cidade de Nazaré.

versos.grego: Τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο πληρούμενον σοφίᾳ, καὶ χάρις Θεοῦ ἦν ἐπ’ αὐτό.

controles.web: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
controles.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
controles.livre: E o menino crescia e se fortalecia, e cheio de sabedoria; e a graça de Deus estava sobre ele.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐπορεύοντο οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ κατ’ ἔτος εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ τῇ ἑορτῇ τοῦ πάσχα.

controles.web: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
controles.kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
controles.livre: Todos os anos, seus pais iam a Jerusalém, para a festa da Páscoa.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἐτῶν δώδεκα, ἀναβαινόντων αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑορτῆς,

controles.web: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,
controles.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
controles.livre: E quando Jesus tinha doze anos, subiram, conforme o costume do festival;

versos.grego: καὶ τελειωσάντων τὰς ἡμέρας, ἐν τῷ ὑποστρέφειν αὐτοὺς ὑπέμεινεν Ἰησοῦς ὁ παῖς ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ, καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
controles.kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
controles.livre: E quando aqueles dias terminaram, eles partiram de volta, mas o menino Jesus ficou em Jerusalém sem que seus pais  soubessem.

versos.grego: νομίσαντες δὲ αὐτὸν εἶναι ἐν τῇ συνοδίᾳ ἦλθον ἡμέρας ὁδὸν καὶ ἀνεζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς συγγενεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς γνωστοῖς,

controles.web: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
controles.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
controles.livre: Porém, como pensavam que ele vinha pelo caminho entre os companheiros de viagem, eles andaram o caminho de um dia; e o procuraram entre os parentes e conhecidos.

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ εὑρόντες ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἀναζητοῦντες αὐτόν.

controles.web: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
controles.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
controles.livre: E como não o acharam, voltaram a Jerusalém em busca dele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ἡμέρας τρεῖς εὗρον αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καθεζόμενον ἐν μέσῳ τῶν διδασκάλων καὶ ἀκούοντα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπερωτῶντα αὐτούς·

controles.web: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, três dias depois, o acharam no templo, sentado no meio dos mestres, ouvindo-os, e perguntando-lhes.

versos.grego: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ συνέσει καὶ ταῖς ἀποκρίσεσιν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
controles.kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
controles.livre: E todos os que o ouviam admiravam a sua inteligência e respostas;

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεπλάγησαν, καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ Τέκνον, τί ἐποίησας ἡμῖν οὕτως; ἰδοὺ ὁ πατήρ σου κἀγὼ ὀδυνώμενοι ζητοῦμέν σε.

controles.web: When they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
controles.kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
controles.livre: Quando eles o viram, ficarm surpresos. E sua mãe lhe disse: Filho, por que fizeste assim conosco? Eis que teu pai e eu com ansiedade te procurávamos.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Τί ὅτι ἐζητεῖτέ με; οὐκ ᾔδειτε ὅτι ἐν τοῖς τοῦ Πατρός μου δεῖ εἶναί με;

controles.web: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?
controles.livre: Ele lhes disse: Por que me procuráveis? Não sabeis que devo estar nos negócios de meu Pai?

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐ συνῆκαν τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
controles.kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
controles.livre: E eles não entenderam as palavras que lhes dizia.

versos.grego: καὶ κατέβη μετ’ αὐτῶν καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρὲθ, καὶ ἦν ὑποτασσόμενος αὐτοῖς. καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ διετήρει πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς.

controles.web: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
controles.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
controles.livre: Então desceu com eles, e veio a Nazaré, e os obedecia. E a sua mãe guardava todas essas coisas no seu coração.

versos.grego: Καὶ Ἰησοῦς προέκοπτεν ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ καὶ ἡλικίᾳ καὶ χάριτι παρὰ Θεῷ καὶ ἀνθρώποις.

controles.web: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
controles.kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
controles.livre: Jesus crescia em sabedoria, em estatura, e em graça para com Deus e as pessoas.
